fidelity: F2a — Coupled Reaction Kinetics + Lumped Thermal ODE
source: Sandrock (1999) J. Alloys Compd. 293-295:877; Jemni & Ben Nasrallah (1995) IJHE 20(1):43; Mayer, Groll & Supper (1987) J. Less-Common Met. 131:235; Chung & Ho (2009) IJHE 34:4351; van't Hoff (1886)

unit.name: Generic LaNi5 Metal-Hydride Bed — Physics-Lumped Kinetics + Thermal

delta_H.note: Enthalpy of hydride formation (absorption, exothermic). Sandrock (1999): LaNi5 dH = -30.1 kJ/mol H2

delta_S.note: Entropy of hydride formation (absorption). Sandrock (1999): LaNi5 dS = -108 J/mol/K (dominated by lost H2 gas entropy)

H_max_wt_pct.note: Max gravimetric H2 capacity LaNi5H6. Sakintuna et al. (2007)

HM_max.note: Max H/M loading: LaNi5 -> LaNi5H6, 6 H atoms per formula unit (Sandrock 1999)

M_alloy.note: Molar mass of LaNi5 (La 138.9 + 5*58.69 g/mol = 432.7 g/mol)

Ca.note: Absorption rate pre-exponential constant. Jemni & Ben Nasrallah (1995), Mayer et al. (1987) for LaNi5

Ea_abs.note: Absorption activation energy. Jemni & Ben Nasrallah (1995): Ea = 21.17 kJ/mol for LaNi5

Cd.note: Desorption rate pre-exponential constant. Jemni & Ben Nasrallah (1995) for LaNi5

Ea_des.note: Desorption activation energy. Jemni & Ben Nasrallah (1995): Ea = 16.42 kJ/mol for LaNi5

P_ref.note: Standard reference pressure (1 atm) for van't Hoff plateau

hysteresis_factor.note: P_abs_plateau = hf * P_des_plateau. Lototskyy et al. (2014)

cp_bed.note: Effective heat capacity of LaNi5 hydride bed. Herbst & Hector (2005); Jemni & Ben Nasrallah (1995): cp ~ 419 J/kg/K

hA_cool.note: Overall bed-to-coolant heat transfer coefficient * area (h*A). Chung & Ho (2009) embedded-tube bed
